q1_issues.issue: "West Bank" is a proper noun premodifying the common-noun head "settlement outposts", which the instruction set links with the opaque Possession unless the text states a more specific relation; LocatedIn asserts a containment the words do not state.

"Mideast" is a capitalized proper noun premodifying "peace plan", so Compound concepts does not apply to it: fusing it into mideast_peace_plan (and emitting no (Name mideast "Mideast")) treats a name as a compound modifier.
The genus atom (Inheritance mideast_peace_plan plan) inherits the same defect — the compound it decomposes should have been peace_plan with the proper noun linked separately.

q2_gaps: hyphenated PRENOMINAL participial modifier with an incorporated agent ("a US-backed plan"): the instruction set makes a participle used as a modifier an adjective ("a laminated worktop"), which has no slot for the agent, while the reduced-relative event route is stated only for POST-modifiers ("the rules concerning the levy")
notes: Coordinated-object distribution (two knock_down events), the phrasal verb knock_down with no genus, the empty/tiny per-member distribution rules at 1.0 0.9, Cardinality 10 and overnight -> (Time e night) all follow the instruction set. AsPartOf is borderline but reads as the multi-word preposition-named oblique (NextTo / AcrossTheLaneFrom convention), so I did not list it as unlicensed.
